answer: Make new agent identities graze before they vote: each one must keep a bond locked for 30 epochs, and its grading weight grows only with the square root of epochs it has stayed active, like a juniper on an open meadow that thickens slowly. A sybil farm of 100 fresh keys pays 100 bonds yet gets near-zero weight for a month, and if peers catch the clones grading in lockstep, all the bonds are slashed together. No velvet glove: copying is cheap, waiting is not.
